summary: Wrote a 3-phase plan scoping implementation to exactly 2 of the 4 dispatched READMEs: Expressiveness/README.md and WeakCanonical/README.md get cols=files-lines generated-inventory blocks with a 4-column Module|Files|Lines|Description header. The two Kamp rollup tables stay unwrapped, since their aggregated 'loose modules' row has no analogue under any existing marker option and NON-GOALS forbid extending the generator. Planning reproduced a destructive gap in the research's recommended procedure: padding only loose-file rows to 4 cells (as recommended) leaves every subdirectory row short, and render_block replaces a short row's description with a TODO placeholder, which wiped all 15 descriptions on a scratch run. The plan corrects this to pad every data row.

artifacts.summary: 3-phase plan: wrap Expressiveness/README.md, wrap WeakCanonical/README.md, then record the Kamp exclusion and run the full gate.
